scope: parallel systematic non-Mundarica source census, exact-locator advancement, deterministic deduplication, rights/consent/cultural-access preservation and audited-release verification

parallel_search_notes.books: Existing verified book/catalogue pathways were rechecked for non-Mundarica advancement; no new book proposition was promoted without exact manifestation support.
parallel_search_notes.dictionaries: Existing Bhaduri, TRI and CIIL/Bharatavani dictionary pathways remain canonical; no lexical row was promoted from inaccessible or rights-uncertain manifestations.
parallel_search_notes.grammars: CIIL/Bhasha Sanchika grammar manifestations remain explicit byte/hash/internal-page gaps; no grammar rule was inferred from catalogue visibility.
parallel_search_notes.peer_reviewed_articles: Known Mundari article pathways and ELR-1000 paper relationship were rechecked; no article-derived cultural proposition was added without exact passage support.
parallel_search_notes.theses_dissertations: Institutional thesis/dissertation pathways remain in census; no participant-derived or fieldwork content was promoted without exact locator, rights and ethics review.
parallel_search_notes.government_tri_census_lsi: Official Census/LSI/TRI gaps remain explicit: authoritative bytes, independent hashes and exact cells/pages are required before numerical or cultural promotion.
parallel_search_notes.archives: Known BnF/LSI and institutional archival pathways remain controlled; no newly discovered archival content was exposed without rights/context verification.
parallel_search_notes.newspapers_periodicals: Secondary reporting remained discovery/corroboration only and did not support a new claim-bearing promotion in this run.
parallel_search_notes.web_resources: Stable institutional/repository manifestations were preferred; unsupported summaries and title-only matches were excluded.
parallel_search_notes.datasets: Karya endangered-recipes-translated-500 was verified as a distinct gated translated release related to ELR-1000. Its public card exposes a Mundari aggregate row and CC BY 4.0 translated-release licence, but gated files were not accessed; individual records were not ingested.
parallel_search_notes.audio: Existing ELR-1000/MunTTS and archive-audio pathways were kept separate from the translated recipe release; no participant audio was ingested.
parallel_search_notes.video: No participant-derived video was ingested or interpreted as cultural evidence in this run.
parallel_search_notes.maps: Known historical/current map pathways remain explicit secondary/locator evidence where primary Census verification is incomplete.
parallel_search_notes.relevant_media: The translated recipe release includes images, but file-level media were gated; zero images or cultural notes were ingested.

primary_advanced_source.verification_level: public dataset-card identity, relationship, gating, licence and aggregate Mundari locator verified
primary_advanced_source.mundari_aggregate: 50 recipes; 315 images; 6.30 average images per recipe; 783 sentence pairs
primary_advanced_source.rights: translated release declares CC BY 4.0; source ELR-1000 is explicitly a separate release with its own KPL BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0 licence
primary_advanced_source.blocked_action: Files and content are gated. No recipe row, translation, image, participant material, cultural note, byte hash or record-level exact locator was acquired or promoted.

deduplication.decision: The translated release is distinct from existing ELR-1000/MunTTS identities, but this run records it as a verification audit rather than modifying permanent MMSC identity counts before gated manifestation access and governance review.

synchronization.mmsc_counts: unchanged at canonical machine-readable source-of-truth values
synchronization.mmsc_arithmetic: 42 audited identities = 14 canonical master + 12 counted Mundarica locator slots + 16 standalone MMSC discoveries; additional federated discoveries 28; still-to-acquire additional discoveries 27
synchronization.streamlit: 42-module mapping, universal search, evidence drilldown, reports/downloads and owner console unchanged; no inaccessible record-level content added
synchronization.evidence_graph: unchanged 52/52/52 because no recipe-level or cultural proposition was promoted
synchronization.coverage_matrix: unchanged live_partial; existing food/media/language coverage is not upgraded from gated record-level content
synchronization.publication: release metrics remain 42 sources, 28 additional federated discoveries and 27 still-to-acquire additions; no numeric regeneration required because controlled counts did not change
synchronization.governance: cultural access continues to override legal/technical entitlement
